title: AI Take Over
description: Tiny survivors. Giant machines. Escape together. A solo or 2-4-player browser adventure through 15 city, forest and factory stages. Share a room code, carry friends over danger, throw debris at robots and race a relentless giant. Three distinct bosses and 33 original anime comic panels tell a story of freedom versus control. Built with OpenAI; the hardest challenge was keeping shared physics, hearts and boss encounters synchronized across independent players.

controls.relay: E: relay, console, memory or debris; F throws held objects
controls.replay: R or Retry stage / Replay stage (host online)
controls.leave: Settings > Leave room / Return to title; Enter after victory
controls.pause: Solo only. Online Esc releases input while the world continues.
controls.continueCampaign: N or Continue after victory (host online)
controls.climb: W/Up and S/Down at ladders; release to hold

limitations: 15-stage solo/co-op campaign implemented; full human playthrough and difficulty balance remain unverified.
